text_en: You can't imagine how many bygul I've had to crush to make this potion.
I'm joking, soldier. The process is painless. Relax, it'll go down easier...
So, according to the instructions, if you haven't fainted, that means it worked.
From now on, you'll notice an even bigger increase in the effects of the <color=OBJ>potions</color> you consume.
To be honest, I'm delighted to have had an excuse to try out all these formulas. You've been an excellent guinea pig.
Now that we've tested the benefits of bygul essence on you, it's time to apply them to the rest of our army.
Thank you for your contribution to magic.
